title: Coordinated Efforts to Connect Graduates with Enterprises for Employment Opportunities
what_it_is: Coordinated Efforts to Connect Graduates with Enterprises for Employment Opportunities

sections.label: Study loan repayment suspended
sections.summary: MOE has suspended repayment and interest for all study loans for one year to give graduates peace of mind during their job search.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: First, they will give graduates peace of mind during their job search, so MOE has suspended the repayment and interest for all study loans, for one year.

sections.label: IHLs contribute job opportunities
sections.summary: IHLs will contribute to the pool of about 100,000 opportunities under the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package overseen by the National Jobs Council.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: IHLs are committed to trying their best to help our graduating students.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: They will contribute to the pool of about 100,000 opportunities under the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package that the National Jobs Council is overseeing and building up.

sections.label: Free CET modules for graduates
sections.summary: IHLs will offer graduates a few Continuing Education and Training modules free of charge, with talks on structuring them into a continuous programme with credentials.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: IHLs will offer their graduates a few Continuing Education and Training (CET) modules free of charge and we are in the process of speaking to the IHLs, structuring all these modules into a continuous programme and with credentials at the end of it.

sections.label: Internship substitutes offered
sections.summary: If rescheduling an internship is not possible, IHLs will offer substitutes such as industry-related projects and additional modules.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: If rescheduling the internship is not possible, IHLs will offer substitutes, such as working on industry-related projects and taking additional modules.
